name: loopskill
description: Curated Claude Code plugins from LoopSkill (app.loopskill.io), the runnable-loop registry for AI agents — plus the LoopSkill meta-skill itself, which connects any agent to the registry to search, install, and run verified skills and loops.

plugins.name: loopskill
plugins.description: Connect your agent to the LoopSkill registry — search, install, run verified loops.

plugins.name: super-memory
plugins.description: One-command installer for the full agent memory stack: cognee 1.0.x knowledge graph (pghybrid), LiteLLM proxy with rotation, cognee-api watchdog cron, nightly ingest pipeline, CouchDB 3 single-node document store, and a filesystem markdown vault wired to Obsidian.

plugins.name: ruthless-mentor
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan, idea, or decision in attack mode — sort proposals into gold / trash / directionally-right-but-flawed and push each to bulletproof.

plugins.name: plan-for-goal
plugins.description: Author a goal-execution plan-doc ready to paste into a goal/issue tracker as discrete, falsifiable goals — with budget, phases, premortem, and acceptance gates.

plugins.name: llm-wiki-hermes
plugins.description: Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: build and maintain a persistent, compounding knowledge base as interlinked markdown files.

plugins.name: hub-search-claude-code
plugins.description: Scanner skill that discovers locally-installed Claude Code skills and community npm plugins before installing a duplicate or authoring a new one from scratch.
